explanation: The old exporter pooled counts across images before selecting one threshold, computing ODS but labeling it pooled OIS. Correct OIS selects each image's best threshold first, then pools those counts.
scope: Correction to supplementary pooled OIS and the focused pooled comparison only. Every per-query score, all 13 main-table means, all model predictions and all other model values are unchanged. This is a reporting correction, not an inference improvement.
numerical_qualification: VICT execution-boundary and reference-parity concerns remain open; aggregation correctness does not resolve them.
